q: Confucius is the philosopher ___ believed in lifelong learning.
explain: 先行词 philosopher 指人，定语从句作主语用 who。

q: The Analects, ___ was written by his disciples, is still read today.
explain: 先行词 The Analects 指物，用 which 引导定语从句。

q: This is the old temple ___ honours Confucius.
explain: 指物的定语从句，口语中常用 that。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Confucius is a teacher he lived 2,500 years ago.
Confucius is a teacher who lived 2,500 years ago.
Confucius is a teacher which lived 2,500 years ago.
explain: 指人用 who，且不能重复主语 he（避免双主语）。

q: The teacher ___ wrote this book is from Shanghai.
explain: 先行词 teacher 指人作主语，用 who。

q: I have a cat ___ can open the door by itself.
explain: 指动物用 which（也可用 that）。

q: She is the teacher ___ teaches us English. （口语中最常用）
explain: 口语中 that 可代替 who/which，尤其信息不可省时。

q: 定语从句通常紧跟在什么之后？
explain: 定语从句告诉我们说的是哪个人或物，通常紧跟在名词之后。

q: 指物或动物时，下列哪个关系词不能用？
explain: who 只指人；指物/动物用 which 或 that。

q: The book ___ I borrowed yesterday is very interesting.
explain: 先行词 book 指物，作宾语用 that（或 which）。

q: Edison is the inventor ___ lab burnt down in 1914.
explain: 表所属关系（发明家的实验室）用 whose。

q: The laboratory ___ Curie worked was very cold in winter.
explain: 先行词是地点 laboratory，从句中作地点状语用 where。

q: 1879 was the year ___ Edison produced a working light bulb.
explain: 先行词是时间 year，用 when 引导。

q: I met a girl ___ father is a scientist.
explain: 表“女孩的父亲”所属关系，用 whose。

q: Paris is the city ___ many great minds once lived.
explain: 先行词是地点 city，从句中表“在该城市”，用 where。

q: I still remember the day ___ the results were announced.
explain: 先行词是时间 day，用 when。

q: "The house where Newton was born" 等于 "The house ___ Newton was born in"。
explain: where = in/at which，故可改为 which + 介词 in。

q: whose 用来表示什么？
explain: whose 表示所属关系，可指人、动物甚至物。

q: This is the village ___ I spent my childhood.
explain: 先行词是地点 village，从句中作地点状语用 where。

q: Summer is the season ___ many people go travelling.
explain: 先行词是时间 season，用 when。

q: The river is ___ dirty ___ swim in.
explain: too + 形容词 + to + 动词，表“太脏以至于不能游泳”。

q: He spoke ___ fast ___ I could not understand him.
explain: so + 副词 + that + 从句结构。

q: "The air is too bad to breathe." 改写为 so...that 结构正确的是：
options: The air is so bad that we cannot breathe.
The air is so bad that we can breathe.
The air is so badly that we cannot breathe.
explain: too...to 含否定义，改 so...that 时从句要加 cannot。

q: There is ___ rubbish on the beach that we cannot walk freely.
explain: rubbish 不可数，用 so much...that。

q: "She is so young that she can't join the club." 改为 too...to 结构：
options: She is too young to join the club.
She is too young not to join the club.
She is so young to join the club.
explain: so young that can't = too young to；to 后不能再加 not。

q: 关于 too...to...，下列说法正确的是：
options: 它本身含否定义，to 后不加 not
explain: too...to 已含“不能”之意，不可在 to 后再加 not。

q: ___ few birds come here now that the forest feels empty.
explain: so few + 名词 + that 结构，表“鸟太少以至于……”。

q: The box is too heavy ___.
explain: too...to + 动词原形；宾语 it 不再重复（box 已是逻辑宾语）。

q: He was ___ tired ___ he fell asleep at once.
explain: so + 形容词 + that + 从句。

q: The water is too cold ___ in.
explain: too + adj. + to + 动词原形。

q: 强调句的基本结构是：
options: It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 其余
There is + 强调部分 + that
It has + 强调部分 + which
explain: 强调句型为 It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。

q: 强调 "Tom broke the window" 的主语，正确的是：
options: It was Tom who broke the window.
It was Tom which broke the window.
It was Tom whom broke the window.
explain: 强调主语且指人，用 who（或 that）。

q: It is plastic ___ pollutes the sea.
explain: 强调部分 plastic 指物，用 that。

q: 强调时间状语 "last Monday" 应该用：
explain: 强调句中无论强调时间或地点，一律用 that，不用 when/where。

q: It was in Shanghai ___ I first met her.
explain: 强调地点状语 in Shanghai，强调句中一律用 that。

q: 强调宾语 "We need clean water most" 的正确改写：
options: It is clean water that we need most.
It is clean water who we need most.
There is clean water that we need most.
explain: 强调宾语 clean water（指物）用 that。

q: 强调句改成否定，正确的是：
options: It was not Tom who broke the window; it was Jim.
It was no Tom who broke the window.
It wasn't Tom broke the window.
explain: 否定强调句：It was not + 强调部分 + who/that...。

q: 关于强调句中其余部分的时态，正确的说法是：
explain: 强调句其余部分保留原时态，不要把第二个动词改成 is。

q: 对主语提问的强调句疑问形式：
options: Who was it that broke the window?
Who it was broke the window?
Who that broke the window was it?
explain: 疑问强调句：Who was it that...？

q: It was last Friday ___ we started the campaign.
explain: 强调时间 last Friday，用 that。

q: 主动句 "They sell tickets online" 的被动语态是：
explain: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词，sell 的过去分词 sold。

q: "Jia Ling directed the film." 的被动语态是：
options: The film was directed by Jia Ling.
The film is directed by Jia Ling.
The film directed by Jia Ling.
explain: 一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词；direct 过去分词 directed。

q: 被动语态中 by + 动作执行者通常在什么时候使用？
options: 当执行者重要或令人意外时
explain: 只有在执行者重要或令人意外时才加 by；显而易见或不明时可省。

q: write 的过去分词是：
explain: write 为不规则动词，过去分词是 written。

q: The building ___ in 1925.
explain: 过去某年用一般过去时被动 was built。

q: "Was the film directed by Jia Ling?" 的正确简短回答：
explain: 被动语态疑问由 be 动词构成，回答用 was。

q: The story ___ in a hurry.（否定）
explain: 被动否定：was not + 过去分词 written。

q: break 的过去分词是：
explain: break 不规则，过去分词为 broken。

q: "Thousands of fans loved the hero." 的被动语态是：
options: The hero was loved by thousands of fans.
The hero is loved thousands of fans.
The hero loved by thousands of fans.
explain: 过去时被动 was loved，执行者重要故保留 by。

q: 被动语态强调的是：
explain: 被动语态聚焦承受动作的对象，而非执行者。

q: 现在完成时被动语态的结构是：
explain: 现在完成时被动：have/has + been + 过去分词。

q: "They have sold all the tickets." 的被动语态是：
options: All the tickets have been sold.
explain: 现在完成被动 have been sold。

q: The hall ___ just ___.
explain: 现在完成被动：has been cleaned，just 放中间。

q: ___ the seats ___ yet?
explain: 现在完成被动疑问：Have the seats been booked yet?

q: The song ___ since 2010.
explain: since 2010 表延续到现在，用现在完成被动 has been sung。

q: 区分："The concert was held last Friday" 与 "The concert has been held three times this year"，后者用现在完成是因为：
explain: this year 表与现在相关的时间段，故用现在完成时。

q: The microphone ___ yet.（否定，现在完成被动）
explain: yet 多与现在完成连用，否定为 has not been fixed。

q: A new album ___ by her.
explain: 现在完成被动 has been recorded。

q: 下列哪个时间词常与现在完成时连用？
explain: already/just/yet/ever/never/since/for 常与现在完成连用。

q: "Has your song been played on the radio?" 是什么时态语态？
explain: have/has + been + 过去分词为现在完成时被动。

q: 转述陈述句 "I am tired," she said. 正确的是：
options: She said that she was tired.
She said that she is tired.
She said that I was tired.
explain: 引述动词为过去时，从句时态后退 am→was，人称 I→she。

q: 转述一般疑问句要用哪个连接词？
explain: 转述一般疑问句用 if 或 whether，并改为陈述句语序。

q: "Are you ready?" he asked. 的间接引语是：
options: He asked if I was ready.
He asked if was I ready.
He asked that I was ready.
explain: 用 if + 陈述句语序，was 后退时态。

q: "Where do you live?" she asked me. 转述为：
options: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where do I live.
explain: 特殊疑问句保留疑问词，改陈述语序，do you live→I lived。

q: 转述时 will 变成：
explain: 间接引语中 will→would。

q: "I saw it yesterday." 转述为：
options: He said he had seen it the day before.
He said he saw it yesterday.
He said he has seen it yesterday.
explain: saw→had seen，yesterday→the day before。

q: 间接引语中 now 通常变为：
explain: now→then，today→that day，here→there。

q: 转述时 can 变成：
explain: 间接引语中 can→could。

q: "Will you help me now?" 转述为：
options: She asked if I would help her then.
She asked if I will help her now.
She asked that I would help her then.
explain: will→would，me→her，now→then，用 if 引导。

q: 转述疑问句时，语序应改为：
explain: 间接疑问句一律用陈述句语序。

q: 对过去行为做猜测/判断的结构是：
options: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词
情态动词 + 动词原形
explain: modal + have + 过去分词用于推测过去。

q: The ground is wet. It ___ last night.
explain: 对过去很肯定的推测用 must have done。

q: She isn't answering. She ___ out.
explain: 对过去的可能推测用 may have gone。

q: "should have done" 通常表达：
options: 本该做却没做（后悔/责备）
explain: should have done 表本应发生却未发生，含后悔或责备。

q: He ___ the money; he was with me all day.
explain: 非常肯定没发生用 can't / couldn't have done。

q: I ___ harder for the test.（含后悔）
explain: 表后悔“本该更努力”用 should have studied。

q: They ___ yet; the flight left only an hour ago.
explain: 很肯定还没到用 couldn't have arrived。

q: He looks happy. He ___ the test.
explain: 由结果很肯定推测过去用 must have passed。

q: "could have done" 还可以表示：
explain: could have done 可表“本来可能/本可以（但没做）”。

q: 这些结构中的“have + 过去分词”部分会随时态变化吗？
explain: 猜测体现在情态动词上，have + 过去分词保持不变。
